prompt: Objective: grow a B2B software company's revenue 50%. What you've learned: existing customers grow spending 5% a year. Latest finding: the company has no product for mid-sized firms, which are 40% of the market. What is the best next step?

options.text: Break existing customers' spending growth down by product
options.feedback: Already answered: about 5% a year, far short of 50%.
Right. A large unserved segment is the finding; size it and what it takes to serve.

options.text: Size the cost of building a mid-market product
options.feedback: Part of the picture, but size the prize before costing the product.

options.text: Compare prices with rivals in the enterprise segment
options.feedback: Off the finding, which is about mid-sized firms.

explanation: Mid-sized firms are 40% of the market and unserved. Size the opportunity and what serving it would take.
